title: schizonepeta tenuifolia var. japonica
intro: Schizonepeta tenuifolia var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese pepperwort or Japanese False Dragonhead, is a perennial herb native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which help to relieve fever, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Schizonepeta tenuifolia var. japonica include its ability to clear heat, relieve toxicity, and promote circulation, making it a valuable herb in traditional Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
